_notes.provenance_note: Poplar scans from the CLS collaboration between Thorsten Knipfer and Mina Momayyezi; per Knipfer's email (Thu Jun 25, addressed to Lawren, Christine, Elizabeth, Santiago Trueba, Craig, Adam, Dula, Guillaume, Richard Harwood), if these scans are included in the manuscript dataset he should be added as a co-author.
_notes.encoding: Devin standard, collapsed from full 8-class scheme to unified 5-class base model
_notes.value_0: Mesophyll (class 3) — annotated as a single undifferentiated mesophyll class, not split into palisade/spongy for this specimen
_notes.mask_check: Verified mask pixel values across all 6 slices = {0, 85, 95, 152, 170, 180, 255}. 55 (Palisade_Mesophyll) is intentionally omitted from the mapping, not just unused: this specimen's annotator labeled a single Mesophyll class (value 0) on purpose, unlike poplar_1/poplar_2 which distinguish palisade (55) from spongy (0)
_notes.full_class_config: poplar_1/poplar_2 use the full native 8-class scheme (Background, Adaxial_Epidermis, Abaxial_Epidermis, Bundle_Sheath, Vascular_Tissue, Palisade_Mesophyll, Spongy_Mesophyll, Air_Space); this specimen was deliberately annotated with a reduced 7-value scheme (single Mesophyll, no palisade/spongy split). Not kept as a separate file, see this file's mapping notes for the full breakdown
